title: Warm Spanish Tomato Gazpacho
description: A comforting and pungent Spanish dish featuring caraway seeds, this warm gazpacho is perfect for a chilly evening, and can be shaped into small nigiri-like bites for a fun presentation.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced red onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cucumber, and cook until they start to soften.
Add the crushed tomatoes, sherry vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use an immersion blender to puree the gazpacho to your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the gazpacho warm, shaped into small nigiri-like bites if desired.
